ana (procurement): FYI Vendor Redline flagged a sensor BOM mismatch on H200 lot for PO-81234. 14 units moved to 'RMA hold' at origin, ETA extended 12d -> 38d. They mentioned cross-dock swap as an option.
ryan (supply-ops): Are these spare pool or reserved for Dedicated? Any serials yet?
ana correction: ana (procurement): Reserved for EU dedicated pool. No serials yet, vendor says lot-level hold pending sensor replacement verification.
mei (eng-mlops): If we lose 14 H200s we'll see ~16% increase in tail latency for nightly batch jobs. We should estimate cost of customer retries + autoscale delta before deciding.
jorge (logistics): Cross-dock swap: vendor can send replacement modules to EU crossdock and swap sensors locally, but that triggers refurb/parts import rules. HS code recategorization might apply. Customs could treat sensor swaps as repair vs new import — affects VAT and duties.
katarina (vendor_redline): Confirmed. The supplier network flagged a sub-batch of temperature sensors. We can do two things: A) ship 8 'pre-validated' units in 10 days with expedited bench tests (fee $350/unit + +10% freight), and schedule sensor swap at your EU crossdock for remaining 6 with ND repair docs; or B) keep full tranche held, offer 6.5% invoice credit. We can also provide loaners (refurb) for up to 30 days at reduced daily rate.
ryan (supply-ops): Need numbers. What9s daily loaner $ and courier for DAP EU? Any risk of customs classifying crossdock swap as import of new goods?
katarina (vendor_redline): Loaners: $85/day/unit. DAP freight estimate \u20ac420 flat. Crossdock sensor-swap paperwork: we provide repair declaration and supplier affidavit to argue repair-only classification; still at customs discretion. If customs reclassify, extra duties could be \u20ac200-700.
mei (eng-mlops): Quick econ: if tail latency adds ~\u20ac28k over 5w, that's about \u20ac2k/unit. Paying expedited + tests (~$350+$110 freight portion =~$460) for 8 units seems cheaper. Loaner fees add up if prolonged.
jorge (logistics): Operational note: sensor swap at crossdock requires a certified technician and 2-3 day hold per unit for QA. Warehouse needs refurb declaration on manifest. Also need serials up front to update node-ids.
nana correction: ana (procurement): Proposal: ask Redline for serial list + firmware payloads now. Accept 8 pre-validated units in 10 days (pay expedited freight + waive test fee on first 4 if we sign addendum committing to Q3 top-off). For remaining 6: request loaners for 30d while vendor does crossdock sensor swap; if crossdock fails or customs reclassifies, vendor absorbs extra duties above \u20ac300 per unit.
ryan (supply-ops): I like that. Also request vendor include explicit HS-code repair declaration and supplier affidavit in documentation to minimize customs risk.
katarina (vendor_redline): We can provide serials + preflight logs EOD and draft repair affidavit. We can agree to absorb excess duties above \u20ac300/unit for swap route if you sign the addendum. Waive test fee on first 4 pre-validated units if addendum signed.
mei (eng-mlops): Also ask for firmware diffs and any thermal calibration vectors. If swap alters calibration we need to run distributed regression test.
jorge (logistics): Once serials and affidavits in, i'll schedule DAP courier and reserved crossdock bay. Ops-bot: create ticket.
ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-9107 - "Vendor Redline H200 sensor BOM RMA hold + crossdock swap plan". Assignees: jorge, ryan, ana. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-9107
ana correction: ana (procurement): Next steps: 1) Katarina sends serials + preflight logs + repair affidavit by EOD; 2) Legal to draft addendum for Q3 commit + duty cap; 3) Logistics to prep crossdock booking on receipt; 4) Eng to validate calibration risk. I'll loop in Finance and Legal.
ryan (supply-ops): tagging @katarina please cc legal@vendor-redline.com.
katarina (vendor_redline): Will do. Serial list + docs incoming EOD. Thanks all.
mei (eng-mlops): One caveat: if we deploy pre-validated units, hold them behind a feature-flag for 48h ramp while telemetry monitors thermal drift.
nana correction: ana (procurement): Good call. We'll include that in rollout checklist.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 72h for INF-9107 follow-up.
